title: Lunch in a pinch. / Sweet & Savory
slide_intent: Show how the ground can change the appetite appeal of a poster while a shared color system keeps the campaign recognizable in public.
strategic_value: Instacart can vary pace between a practical lunch message and a more indulgent food story without inventing a separate poster identity.
demonstration: Two photographed placements fill the spread. The narrow green poster places its headline above a food photograph. The wide pale poster puts the headline beside a dessert photograph.
practical_value: Compare a stacked vertical layout with a split horizontal one when choosing where to place an image and how strongly the background should register.

content_islands.name: Vertical placement
content_islands.spec: Fill the left portion with the transit setting. Stack light type, a rounded photograph and the small signature on a Kale field.

content_islands.name: Horizontal placement
content_islands.spec: Give the right portion to the wall-mounted poster. Put the dark headline and signature on the pale left half and crop the photograph tightly at right.
